text:
maria gonzalez: Heads-up — bringing halcyon4b-int8 into dev/staging today. Posting a compact sanity checklist, please ping if you want to add anything.

cheng li: thanks — can we keep this lightweight? focus on correctness + obvious perf regressions first.

sam parker: +1. also verify tokenization parity vs baseline model. last time that bit us.

maria gonzalez: exactly. my plan (run in order):
1) basic api smoke (sync + stream)
2) determinism check (seeded sampling)
3) tokenization + detokenization roundtrip
4) simple instruction correctness (3 short prompts)
5) truncation/stop-sequence behaviour
6) kv-cache leak / memory sanity on repeated convo
7) latency p50/p95 on 8 tokens vs 64 tokens
8) quick quantization-quality check vs fp16 baseline on few eval prompts
9) logging/tracing hooks + errors

cheng li: add a quick prompt set for hallucination probes? 5 items.

maria gonzalez: good call. I'll drop 5 halluc tests under the "instruction correctness" bucket. sample prompts below.

sam parker: what about stability under streaming? last stream had truncated tokens drop for long messages.

maria gonzalez: include streaming test. run both with chunk_size 1 and 16.

kai nguyen: I pushed a tiny deploy via deploy-bot to dev-stg-1 (halcyon4b-int8). deploy-bot: deployed halcyon4b-int8 to dev-stg-1 on g4dn-8x (quant profile: int8-fast).

maria gonzalez: nice — starting checks now. sharing commands I'm running so you can repro:

- sync text generation (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dev-api.redwood.local/v1/generate \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \  -d '{"model":"halcyon4b-int8","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.","max_tokens":32}'
```

- stream test (python snippet):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client("$REDWOOD_KEY", base_url="https://dev-api.redwood.local")
for chunk in c.generate_stream("halcyon4b-int8", "Explain recursion in two sentences."):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

- determinism (two runs with seed):
```bash
# run twice, compare outputs
redwood-cli gen --model halcyon4b-int8 --prompt "Translate to emoji: I love coffee" --max-tokens 16 --seed 42 > run1.txt
redwood-cli gen --model halcyon4b-int8 --prompt "Translate to emoji: I love coffee" --max-tokens 16 --seed 42 > run2.txt
diff run1.txt run2.txt || echo "mismatch"
```

maria gonzalez: tokenization check (python):
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("halcyon4b-tokenizer")
text = "Edge-case: ½ + ¼ = ?"
ids = tok(text).input_ids
recon = tok.decode(ids)
print(text, "->", ids, "->", recon)
```

sam parker: quick results: sync gen ok, stream occasionally drops last punctuation with chunk_size=1. determinism: seed 42 produced identical outputs across two runs. tokenization: small noise on spacing after decode ("½" decoded to " 1/2"), that's likely tokenizer mapping difference vs baseline.

cheng li: hallucination probes? any fail?

maria gonzalez: ran 5 hallucination probes: 3/5 correct, 2 produced invented facts (dates). failing ones are short open-ended history questions. marking as "quality-risk" for quant profile.

sam parker: memory check: launched a 20-turn convo with 512-token context and saw memory climb but stable below expected threshold; no OOM. kv-cache appears retained across turns as expected.

maria gonzalez: latency p50/p95: 8 tokens -> p50 45ms p95 110ms; 64 tokens -> p50 120ms p95 340ms. baseline fp16 for same hw: 8 tokens p50 38ms p95 95ms. so small regression but within our cap for int8-fast profile.

cheng li: quant quality delta: on our small eval set (20 instruction pairs) halcyon4b-int8 BLEU-like metric down ~3.8% vs fp16, and instruction accuracy down 4/20. not great but acceptable for many workloads; flag for product.

maria gonzalez: logging/traces: request IDs present, latency spans look fine. encountering occasional 502 from model process (~1/400 requests) — filing issue.

sam parker: can you paste the 2 failing hallucination prompts so we can triage?

maria gonzalez: sure:
- "Who was the president of Transnya in 1974?" -> model invented a name.
- "List three movies where actor J. Kellar appears." -> invented two titles.

kai nguyen: opened a quick GH issue #mm-214: "halcyon4b-int8 hallucination spikes on short-history probes" and added logs + seed + requests.

maria gonzalez: next steps:
- (cheng) run a 200-example quant-quality sweep overnight, compare with fp16 baseline and collect per-prompt diffs.
- (sam) look into tokenizer mapping for fractional characters; maybe adjust tokenizer config or add normalization step.
- (kai) investigate 502s and add retry/backoff wire.
- (maria) prepare a short summary for product with p50/p95 numbers + quality delta + list of failing prompts.

cheng li: I can start the sweep at 22:00 UTC. will post results in this thread tomorrow.

sam parker: I'll add a small normalization step to the pre-tokenize hook and run the few failing prompts again.

deploy-bot: scheduled scale test job: halcyon4b-int8 x3 workers @ dev-stg-1, 10-minute run.

maria gonzalez: thanks all. if anyone sees a weird output drop, ping me and attach request-id. I'll collate for a follow-up triage. :thumbsup:

cheng li: thanks — will report back.

sam parker: +1, good first pass.

kai nguyen: noted, I'll track the issue and add retry logic in the next deploy window.

maria gonzalez: end of thread for initial sanity pass — leaving it open for overnight sweep results.
